levels.surface: عبد السلام بن أبي حازم أبو طالوت

notes: فلان: a man the text does not name; the compiler's own note (سماه مسلم) names him outside the text, so he is an unnamed link (rule 8).
قال شهدت: Abd al-Salam's own witness of Abu Barza's entrance; Ubayd Allah ibn Ziyad is in the scene, not a link.
Abu Barza's answer (نعم لا مرة ولا ثنتين) is the saying, so he is the last link.
